text: The encode-decode method proves (base=ₛ₁ base) ≃ ℤ by:
choices: defining a code family, encode via transport, decode via the S¹ eliminator, then showing they are inverse
propositional truncation of the loop space
explanation: Encode-decode: code→encode→decode→inverse proofs. This is the canonical technique for homotopy group computations in HoTT.
